name: ObstacleMode
declaration: public enum ObstacleMode : uint
summary: How the navigation reacts to a dynamic obstacle.

values.name: Carve
values.summary: Cut the box out of the navmesh (background tile rebake). Paths go around.

values.name: Area
values.summary: Relabel the box with area, whose per-type cost decides avoidance.

values.name: Avoid
values.summary: No rebake: local avoidance only (moving carts, temporary crowds).
